svg.title: YARN NodeManager: Localize, Launch & Enforce
svg.desc: ContainerManagerImpl auth, localizer HDFS fetch, ContainerExecutor launch, and PMEM kill. 1. YarnAllocator to NodeManager: startContainers (worker-b:45454); 2. NodeManager to HDFS DataNode: Localize __spark_conf__ (dn:9866); 3. NodeManager to YARN Container: launchContainer (OS) (worker-b OS); 4. YARN Container to ExecutorBackend: Exec ExecutorBackend (worker-b proc); 5. YARN Container to NodeManager: Exit -104 (EXCEEDED_PMEM) (worker-b OS); 6. NodeManager to ResourceManager: nodeHeartbeat (COMPLETE) (rm01:8031)
